name: scientific-figure-workflow
description: A collaborative paper-to-prompt-to-PNG-to-editable-PPT workflow with independent QA.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborative scientific figure production and QA.
interface.longDescription: Coordinate prompt compilation, high-resolution PNG rendering, hybrid editable PowerPoint reconstruction, and independent QA through reproducible file handoffs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $figure-workflow to turn my paper or reference figure into a reviewed high-resolution PNG and a hybrid editable PowerPoint.
